answer: Because the sable release is recorded with every signature, the pigment audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the zephyr graph and each risks its bond. That is 6 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
